row.name: Mary Mcleod Bethune Early Child Development Nursery

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation failed to notify licensing before the two-day period of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The fire and health inspection reports were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 21, 2025, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: The operation failed to submit the required information within the compliance date. This is a re-cite.     Three out of four staff were missing trainings in this category.     One out of three staff was missing child maltreatment, and sids, shaken baby and early brain development training.    One out of three staff were missing communicable diseases including immunizations, administering medication, food allergies, and building and premises safety training.    One out of three staff was missing administering medication training, food allergies, hazardous materials and blood borne pathogens, and emergency preparedness training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three out of four staff were missing trainings in this category.     One out of three staff was missing child maltreatment, and sids, shaken baby and early brain development training.    One out of three staff were missing communicable diseases including immunizations, administering medication, food allergies, and building and premises safety training.    One out of three staff was missing administering medication training, food allergies, hazardous materials and blood borne pathogens, and emergency preparedness training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: An employee caring for children, did not use good judgement when she inappropriately redirected two children away from a doorway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 5 year old child was left unsuperviosed and observed to be outside of the classroom alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One center employee that was present at the operation with access to the children, did not have a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Three shelves in two classrooms were observed to not be in good repair and unsanitary. In one classroom, a cleaning supply bottle with chemicals was observed to be with in access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: Two adult volunteers completing community service hours through the court system and one maintenance worker, were found to be frequently present and have unsupervised access to the children, without an initial or cleared background check on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: The operation has been serving foods to children that are stored and/or cooked beyond the shelf-life/expiration dates, which is unsafe for consumption.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The center director did not maintain documentation to record hours worked at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director allowed a person that was found to need a background check, back into the operation after being told by a Child Care Regulation inspector, that they could not be present without a cleared background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The operation does not have documentation of monthly carbon monoxide detector testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor playground was observed to have the following hazards: a broken table propped against the shed with legs  sticking straight out, two chain fence doors propped up posing a fall hazard, a wooden table with broken seats and table top,  posing hazards to the children. Also in the indoor infant classroom, a shelf that is broken with chiipped paint and tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Three fire extinguishers indoors and one fire extinguisher used for transportation in the van were observed to not be serviced. The pressure gauges are all now in the green zone and tagged with a current date of October 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The fire inspection was observed to be expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drill exit times were documented and observed to be over 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Three sheets out of five cribs that were observed, have loose fitted sheets and a risk for entanglment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Three fire extinguishers indoors and one  fire extinghuiser used for transportation in the van were observed to not be servised and the pressure gauges in the red zone and expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The operation does not have documentaiton of monthly carbon monoxide detector testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor playground was observed to have the following hazards: a broken table propped against the shed with legs sticking straight out, two chain fence doors propped up posing a fall hazard, a wooden table with broken seats and table top, posing hazards to the children. Also in the indoor infant classroom, a shelf that is broken with chiipped paint and tape.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Responsible for Each Child: In the infant room there were seven infants to one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Responsible for Each Child (26 TAC §746.1501(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was viewed asleep in a bouncer upon inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check: A background check renewal was not done upon inspection and was inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check (26 TAC §745.621(b)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision: Four children were viewed hiding under an opening of the bleachers playing hide and seek.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §746.4601(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Hazardous materials were accessible to children under the children's sink.    The hazardous materials were removed from the classroom upon inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Infant was in a bouncer prop up with a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three out of ten children's records were lacking their immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There was not enough loose fill in play zone areas.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In two rooms there was chipped paint missing from the walls accessible to children. In another room there was a shelf that was missing pieces of wood and paint missing as well.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
